source_id: BW-PSM-01 rows 1-6 internal fulfilment full-receipt path
purpose: Verify the complete internal stock fulfilment path from submission to stock posting with full receipt
preconditions: Employee, Department Admin and an authorized receiving actor exist with correct roles; allocable departmental/central stock >= requested quantity; indent in Draft/Not Submitted
action_or_input: 1) Employee submits a valid indent. 2) Dept Admin runs Check and Reserve Stock. 3) Dept Admin reviews and approves for internal issue. 4) Dept Admin records pick/dispatch. 5) Authorized receiving actor inspects and records GRN accepting full quantity. 6) Employee confirms delivery receipt.
expected_result: States progress in order: Submitted -> Stock Reserved -> Internal Issue Approved -> Dispatched / Ready for Receipt -> GRN Accepted / Partial -> Receipt Confirmed / Stock Posted. Stock is reserved at step 2 and inventory is posted only after step 6. Each transition is audit-logged.

source_id: BW-PSM-01 row 5 receipt accepted (partial) and row 6 accepted portion confirmed
purpose: Verify partial receipt on the internal path posts stock only for the accepted portion
preconditions: Indent is in Dispatched / Ready for Receipt for quantity N
action_or_input: Authorized receiving actor records GRN accepting M < N units; Employee then confirms receipt of the accepted portion; no discrepancy is unresolved.
expected_result: GRN Accepted / Partial is reached, then Receipt Confirmed / Stock Posted; inventory is updated only for the M accepted units.

source_id: BW-PSM-01 row 6 guard: no unresolved discrepancy
purpose: Verify stock is not posted while a discrepancy is unresolved
preconditions: Indent is in GRN Accepted / Partial with an unresolved discrepancy recorded against the receipt
action_or_input: Employee attempts Confirm Delivery Receipt (PSM-UC-002).
expected_result: Transition to Receipt Confirmed / Stock Posted does not occur and inventory is not updated while the discrepancy is unresolved.

source_id: BW-PSM-02 rows 1-5 standard external authorization path
purpose: Verify the standard external procurement authorization path where final Director/Registrar review is not required
preconditions: Employee, Dept Admin, Dept Head, PS Admin exist; allocable stock is insufficient; configured policy does not require final authority review; Department Head review is required
action_or_input: 1) Employee submits indent. 2) Dept Admin performs Check and Reserve Stock. 3) Dept Admin approves for further processing. 4) Dept Head reviews and recommends onward. 5) PS Admin reviews and selects procurement method.
expected_result: States progress: Submitted -> External Procurement Required -> Department Reviewed -> Department Head Recommended -> Procurement Authorized / Method Selected. No Awaiting Final Approval state is entered.

source_id: BW-PSM-03 rows 1-6 final authority approval path
purpose: Verify the final authority path through Director/Registrar approval
preconditions: Allocable stock is insufficient; configured policy requires final authority review; all actors exist with correct roles
action_or_input: 1) Employee submits indent. 2) Dept Admin checks stock (insufficient). 3) Dept Admin approves. 4) Dept Head recommends onward. 5) PS Admin records recommendation. 6) Director/Registrar approves in Final Review and Approval.
expected_result: States progress: Submitted -> External Procurement Required -> Department Reviewed -> Department Head Recommended -> Awaiting Final Approval -> Procurement Authorized / Method Selected. Each decision is audit-logged.

source_id: BW-PSM-03 row 5/6 final authority gating
purpose: Verify procurement is not authorized before Director/Registrar approval when final authority review is required
preconditions: Indent is in Awaiting Final Approval
action_or_input: Attempt to issue a PO or advance to Procurement Authorized without a Director/Registrar approval.
expected_result: Indent remains in Awaiting Final Approval; Procurement Authorized is reached only after Director/Registrar approves.

source_id: BW-PSM-04 rows 1-6 direct procurement to payment, full payment
purpose: Verify the complete direct procurement path from PO to payment
preconditions: Indent is Procurement Authorized / Direct Selected; vendor is verified; required approvals complete; PO, GRN and invoice quantities/amounts agree
action_or_input: 1) PS Admin creates and issues PO. 2) PS Admin updates delivery status to delivered. 3) Authorized receiving actor inspects and records GRN accepting goods. 4) Employee confirms delivery receipt. 5) Accounts Admin verifies invoice by three-way match. 6) Accounts Admin processes payment.
expected_result: States progress: PO Issued -> Delivered -> GRN Accepted -> Receipt Confirmed -> Invoice Verified -> Paid. PO is linked to indent and vendor; stock is updated for accepted quantities only after delivery confirmation.

source_id: BW-PSM-04 row 1 guard: vendor verified and required approvals complete
purpose: Verify PO issuance is blocked for an unverified vendor
preconditions: Procurement Authorized / Direct Selected; selected vendor is not verified in vendor master
action_or_input: PS Admin attempts Create and Issue Purchase Order.
expected_result: PO is not issued; state remains Procurement Authorized / Direct Selected.

source_id: BW-PSM-04 row 6 outcome Partially Paid
purpose: Verify the Partially Paid outcome of payment processing
preconditions: Invoice is in Invoice Verified; partial-payment rules are configured and only part of the amount is eligible
action_or_input: Accounts Admin processes vendor payment for the eligible portion.
expected_result: State becomes Partially Paid; only the eligible amount is paid.

source_id: BW-PSM-04 row 5 guard: three-way match mismatch places invoice on hold
purpose: Verify an invoice that fails three-way matching is not verified and is held
preconditions: Receipt Confirmed; invoice amount/quantity does not match PO and GRN
action_or_input: Accounts Admin runs Verify Invoice.
expected_result: Invoice is not set to Invoice Verified; invoice is placed on hold and no payment is released.

source_id: BW-PSM-05 rows 1-7 tender procurement to payment
purpose: Verify the complete tender procurement path from tender selection to payment
preconditions: Indent is Procurement Authorized / Tender Selected; Procurement Committee exists; selected vendor verified; PO/GRN/invoice agree
action_or_input: 1) PS Admin records committee-approved tender selection. 2) PS Admin creates and issues PO. 3) Delivery marked delivered. 4) Authorized receiving actor records GRN accepted. 5) Employee confirms receipt. 6) Accounts Admin verifies invoice. 7) Accounts Admin processes payment.
expected_result: States progress: Tender Vendor Selected -> PO Issued -> Delivered -> GRN Accepted -> Receipt Confirmed -> Invoice Verified -> Paid / Partially Paid.

source_id: BW-PSM-05 row 1 guard: committee-approved selection recorded
purpose: Verify a tender vendor cannot be selected without committee-approved selection
preconditions: Indent is Procurement Authorized / Tender Selected; no committee approval recorded for bids
action_or_input: PS Admin attempts to record a tender vendor selection.
expected_result: Tender Vendor Selected is not reached; no PO can be issued.

source_id: BW-PSM-06 rows 1-5 discrepancy return/adjustment path
purpose: Verify discrepancy resolved by return/adjustment, through to payment/closure
preconditions: Goods are Delivered/Under Inspection and contain damaged/short items; Vendor, PS Admin, Accounts Admin exist
action_or_input: 1) Receiving actor records discrepancy/rejection at inspection. 2) Receiving actor reports discrepancy with evidence and requests return/adjustment. 3) PS Admin resolves case with return/adjustment, no replacement. 4) Accounts Admin verifies remaining invoice. 5) Accounts Admin processes payment for eligible amount.
expected_result: States progress: Discrepancy Identified -> Discrepancy Case Open -> Case Resolved / Adjustments Posted -> Invoice Verified or Closed -> Paid / Closed. Inventory/accounting adjustments are posted and vendor communication is tracked.

source_id: BW-PSM-10 rows 1-5 one replacement traversal
purpose: Verify discrepancy resolved by exactly one replacement through to payment
preconditions: Discrepancy case is Open for a received PO item
action_or_input: 1) PS Admin selects/records replacement. 2) Receiving actor inspects replacement delivery and records GRN accepted. 3) Employee confirms replacement receipt. 4) Accounts Admin verifies invoice/adjustment. 5) Accounts Admin processes payment.
expected_result: States progress: Replacement Awaited -> Replacement GRN Accepted -> Replacement Confirmed -> Invoice Verified -> Paid / Partially Paid.

source_id: BW-PSM-07 rows 1-3 modify pending indent and re-review
purpose: Verify modification of a pending indent in a permissible state returns it to review and onward
preconditions: Indent is Submitted/Pending in a modifiable state; Dept Head review is configured
action_or_input: 1) Employee modifies indent with valid changes. 2) Dept Admin completes review. 3) Dept Head reviews and records recommendation.
expected_result: States progress: Modified / Awaiting Re-review -> Department Reviewed -> Department Head Recommended. The modification is retained as a distinct version and audit-logged.

source_id: BW-PSM-07 row 1 guard: modification permitted
purpose: Verify modification is rejected when the indent is not in a modifiable state
preconditions: Indent is in a state not permitting modification
action_or_input: Employee attempts Modify Pending Indent.
expected_result: Modification is refused; state unchanged; no new version created.

source_id: BW-PSM-07 row 1 guard: modified version validates
purpose: Verify an invalid modified version (mandatory field missing) is not accepted
preconditions: Indent is in a modifiable state
action_or_input: Employee modifies the indent leaving a mandatory field empty.
expected_result: Validation error; state does not change to Modified / Awaiting Re-review.

source_id: BW-PSM-08 rows 1-3 inter-departmental stock transfer
purpose: Verify the complete stock transfer path with ledger updates at completion
preconditions: Source department has sufficient allocable stock; Requesting, Source and Destination Dept Admins exist
action_or_input: 1) Requesting Dept Admin submits a valid transfer request. 2) Source Dept Admin processes and dispatches. 3) Destination Dept Admin confirms receipt.
expected_result: States progress: Transfer Requested -> Transfer Dispatched -> Transfer Completed / Ledgers Updated. Transfer stock is reserved on dispatch; source and destination ledgers are updated only at completion; audit trail recorded.

source_id: BW-PSM-08 row 2 guard: sufficient allocable stock
purpose: Verify transfer is not dispatched when source stock is insufficient
preconditions: Transfer is Transfer Requested; source allocable stock < requested quantity
action_or_input: Source Dept Admin attempts Process and Dispatch Stock Transfer.
expected_result: Transfer Dispatched is not reached; ledgers unchanged.

source_id: CW-PSM-01 row 1/2 stock check routing decision
purpose: Verify the stock check routes a submitted indent to the internal path or external procurement based on allocable stock
preconditions: Two submitted indents: one with sufficient allocable stock, one with insufficient
action_or_input: Dept Admin runs Check and Reserve Stock on both indents.
expected_result: Sufficient-stock indent becomes Stock Reserved / Internal Path; insufficient-stock indent becomes External Procurement Required.

source_id: CW-PSM-01 rows 3-4 routing by cost/priority policy with Dept Head included in configured path
purpose: Verify Dept Admin approval assigns the next review per configured cost/priority policy and Dept Head recommends when included
preconditions: Indent is External Procurement Required; approval policy configured so Dept Head is included in the path
action_or_input: Dept Admin approves the indent; Dept Head recommends onward.
expected_result: State becomes Department Reviewed / Next Review Assigned, with the next reviewer per configured policy, then Department Head Recommended.

source_id: CW-PSM-01 rows 5-6 outcome Awaiting Final Approval then Authorized
purpose: Verify PS Admin review in the composite flow yields Awaiting Final Approval when required and Procurement Authorized after Director/Registrar approval
preconditions: Indent is Department Head Recommended; policy configured to require final approval
action_or_input: PS Admin completes procurement review; Director/Registrar approves.
expected_result: State becomes Awaiting Final Approval, then Procurement Authorized.

source_id: CW-PSM-01 rows 7-8 tender method and PO issuance after tender; row 8 direct method
purpose: Verify method branching: tender method goes through tender vendor selection before PO; direct method issues PO directly
preconditions: Two Procurement Authorized indents: one with tender method, one with direct method; vendors verified; gates satisfied
action_or_input: For tender indent: PS Admin runs Tender Management, then issues PO. For direct indent: PS Admin issues PO.
expected_result: Tender indent: Tender Vendor Selected then PO Issued. Direct indent: PO Issued without a tender step.

source_id: CW-PSM-01 row 9 internal issue path
purpose: Verify internal issue from Stock Reserved / Internal Path reaches Dispatched / Ready for Receipt
preconditions: Indent is Stock Reserved / Internal Path with internal issue approved
action_or_input: Dept Admin runs Process Internal Stock Issue.
expected_result: State becomes Dispatched / Ready for Receipt.

source_id: CW-PSM-02 rows 1-3 delivery inspection outcome branch
purpose: Verify inspection of a delivery branches to GRN Accepted or Discrepancy Identified, and confirmation requires no unresolved discrepancy
preconditions: Two delivered POs: one with conforming goods, one with discrepant goods
action_or_input: Receiving actor inspects both; Employee confirms receipt of the accepted one.
expected_result: Conforming delivery -> GRN Accepted -> Receipt Confirmed. Discrepant delivery -> Discrepancy Identified.

source_id: CW-PSM-02 rows 5-6 case resolution branch (return/adjustment vs replacement)
purpose: Verify an open discrepancy case branches by resolution type
preconditions: Two Discrepancy Case Open cases
action_or_input: PS Admin resolves one with return/adjustment and the other with replacement.
expected_result: Return/adjustment case -> Case Resolved / Adjustments Posted; replacement case -> Replacement Awaited.

source_id: CW-PSM-02 row 7 exactly one replacement received and accepted
purpose: Verify exactly one replacement delivery is accepted for a replacement case
preconditions: Case is Replacement Awaited
action_or_input: Receiving actor inspects and accepts one replacement delivery.
expected_result: State becomes Replacement GRN Accepted; the replacement traversal is complete after exactly one replacement.

source_id: CW-PSM-02 rows 8-9 invoice verification from alternate source states and payment
purpose: Verify invoice verification and payment are reachable from Receipt Confirmed, Replacement GRN Accepted and Case Resolved states
preconditions: Three items in states Receipt Confirmed, Replacement GRN Accepted, and Case Resolved, each with a matching invoice for eligible accepted receipt
action_or_input: Accounts Admin verifies each invoice, then processes payment.
expected_result: Each becomes Invoice Verified, then Paid / Partially Paid.
